title: Québec Mega Trail — FAQ
claims: The FAQ states that the information displayed refers to the 2027 edition.
Only QMT135 entrants must undergo a mandatory gear check before the start; other races face random checks on course.
Poles are allowed except in the Mestachibo section of the 135 km, 80 km and 50 km races, must be carried for the whole race and may not be placed in drop bags.
There is no waiting list; places freed by cancellations and refunds are released in batches after the 16 December, 16 March and 16 May refund deadlines.
Bib transfers are no longer allowed.
Pacers are accepted only on QMT135; a pacer bib costs CAD 10 in cash, can be bought online at runreg.com/qmt2026 or on site, and pacers must carry the same mandatory gear as the runner.
The FAQ directs runners looking for KML or GPS files to the bottom of the Course Map section on the race page.
The FAQ links the 2027 registration page to raceroster.com/events/2027/130223/quebec-mega-trail.
